Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ بَدِيعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: O Allah, praise belongs to You, Originator of the heavens and the earth

Arabic text: ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
Translation: Possessor of majesty and honor

Arabic text: رَبَّ الْأَرْبَابِ وَ إِلَهَ كُلِّ مَأْلُوهٍ
Translation: Lord of lords and God of everything worshipped

Arabic text: وَ خَالِقَ كُلِّ مَخْلُوقٍ
Translation: Creator of everything created

Arabic text: وَ وَارِثَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ
Translation: Inheritor of all things, nothing is like You

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ عِلْمُ شَيْء
Translation: No knowledge of anything escapes You

Arabic text: وَ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطٌ
Translation: And You encompass everything

Arabic text: وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَقِيبٌ
Translation: And You are the Watcher over everything

Arabic text: أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الْمُتَوَحِّدُ الْفَرْدُ الْمُتَفَرِّدُ
Translation: You are Allah, there is no god but You, the One, the Unique, the Singular, the Peerless

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الْمُتَكَرِّمُ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Generous, the Most Generous

Arabic text: اَلْعَظِيمُ الْمُتَعَظِّمُ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ
Translation: The Great, the Most Great, the Grand, the Most Grand

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْعَلِيُّ الْمُتَعَالِ الشَّدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Most High, the Exalted, the Strong in Might

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful, the All-Knowing, the Wise

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ الْقَدِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing, the Eternal, the All-Aware

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الْأَكْرَمُ الدَّائِمُ الْأَدْوَمُ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Generous, the Most Generous, the Everlasting, the Most Enduring

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the First

Arabic text: قَبْلَ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ وَ الْآخِرُ بَعْدَ كُلِّ عَدَدٍ
Translation: Before anyone, and the Last after everything

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الدَّانِيْ فِيْ عُلُوِّهِ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Near in His exaltedness

Arabic text: وَ الْعَالِيْ فِيْ دُنُوِّهِ
Translation: And the High in His nearness

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ذُوْ الْبَهَاءِ وَ الْمَجْدِ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَ الْحَمْدِ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, Possessor of Splendor, Glory, Greatness and Praise

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ أَنْشَأْتَ الْأَشْيَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سِنْخٍ
Translation: And You are Allah, there is no god but You, who created all things from nothing

Arabic text: وَ صَوَّرْتَ مَا صَوَّرْتَ مِنْ غَيْرِ مِثَالٍ
Translation: And designed what You designed without a model

Arabic text: وَ ابْتَدَعْتَ الْمُبْتَدَعَاتِ بِلَا احْتِذَاءٍ
Translation: And originated creations without imitation

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ قَدَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَقْدِيرًا
Translation: You are the One who ordained everything perfectly

Arabic text: وَ يَسَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَيْسِيرًا
Translation: And made everything easy with facilitation

Arabic text: وَ دَبَّرْتَ مَا دُونَكَ تَدْبِيرًا
Translation: And managed what is below You with perfect arrangement

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يُعِنْكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ شَرِيكٌ
Translation: You are the One whom no partner helped in Your creation

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يُوَازِرْكَ فِيْ أَمْرِكَ وَزِيرٌ
Translation: And no minister assisted You in Your command

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ مُشَاهِدٌ وَ لَا نَظِيرٌ
Translation: And You had no witness and no equal

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ أَرَدْتَ فَكَانَ حَتْمًا مَا أَرَدْتَ
Translation: You are the One who willed, and what You willed was inevitable

Arabic text: وَ قَضَيْتَ فَكَانَ عَدْلًا مَا قَضَيْتَ
Translation: And You judged, and what You judged was just

Arabic text: وَ حَكَمْتَ فَكَانَ نِصْفًا مَا حَكَمْتَ
Translation: And You ruled, and what You ruled was fair

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا يَحْوِيكَ مَكَانٌ
Translation: You are the One whom no place can contain

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَقُمْ لِسُلْطَانِكَ سُلْطَانٌ
Translation: And no authority can stand against Your authority

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يُعْيِكَ بُرْهَانٌ وَ لَا بَيَانٌ
Translation: And no proof or evidence can exhaust You

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ أَحْصَيْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا
Translation: You are the One who has counted everything in number

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَمَدًا
Translation: And set a term for everything

Arabic text: وَ قَدَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَقْدِيرًا
Translation: And ordained everything with precision

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ قَصُرَتِ الْأَوْهَامُ عَنْ ذَاتِيَّتِكَ
Translation: You are the One from whose essence imaginations fall short

Arabic text: وَ عَجَزَتِ الْأَفْهَامُ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And understanding fails to grasp Your nature

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تُدْرِكِ الْأَبْصَارُ مَوْضِعَ أَيْنِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And eyes cannot perceive Your whereabouts

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا تُحَدُّ فَتَكُونَ مَحْدُودًا
Translation: You are the One who cannot be limited to be bounded

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تُمَثَّلْ فَتَكُونَ مَوْجُودًا
Translation: And cannot be exemplified to be found

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تَلِدْ فَتَكُونَ مَوْلُودًا
Translation: And did not beget to be born

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا ضِدَّ مَعَكَ فَيُعَانِدَكَ
Translation: You are the One who has no opponent to resist You

Arabic text: وَ لَا عِدْلَ لَكَ فَيُكَاثِرَكَ وَ لَا نِدَّ لَكَ فَيُعَارِضَكَ
Translation: And no equal to rival You, and no peer to oppose You

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ ابْتَدَأَ وَ اخْتَرَعَ
Translation: You are the One who initiated and invented

Arabic text: وَ اسْتَحْدَثَ وَ ابْتَدَعَ
Translation: And brought into being and created

Arabic text: وَ أَحْسَنَ صُنْعَ مَا صَنَعَ
Translation: And made excellent all that You made

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَجَلَّ شَأْنَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! How majestic is Your status!

Arabic text: وَ أَسْنَى فِيْ الْأَمَاكِنِ مَكَانَكَ
Translation: How exalted is Your place among all places!

Arabic text: وَ أَصْدَعَ بِالْحَقِّ فُرْقَانَكَ
Translation: How clearly Your criterion distinguishes truth!

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ مِنْ لَطِيفٍ مَا أَلْطَفَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! How subtle You are in Your subtlety!

Arabic text: وَ رَؤُوفٍ مَا أَرْأَفَكَ وَ حَكِيمٍ مَا أَعْرَفَكَ
Translation: How compassionate in Your compassion! How wise in Your wisdom!

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ مِنْ مَلِيكٍ مَا أَمْنَعَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! How mighty You are in Your might!

Arabic text: وَ جَوَادٍ مَا أَوْسَعَكَ وَ رَفِيعٍ مَا أَرْفَعَكَ
Translation: How generous in Your generosity! How lofty in Your loftiness!

Arabic text: ذُوْ الْبَهَاءِ وَ الْمَجْدِ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَ الْحَمْدِ
Translation: Possessor of splendor, glory, greatness, and praise

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ بَسَطْتَ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ يَدَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! You have extended Your hand with blessings

Arabic text: وَ عُرِفَتِ الْهِدَايَةُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
Translation: And guidance is recognized as coming from You

Arabic text: فَمَنِ الْتَمَسَكَ لِدِينٍ أَوْ دُنْيَا وَجَدَكَ
Translation: So whoever seeks You for religion or worldly life finds You

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ خَضَعَ لَكَ مَنْ جَرَى فِيْ عِلْمِكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! All who are in Your knowledge submit to You

Arabic text: وَ خَشَعَ لِعَظَمَتِكَ مَا دُوْنَ عَرْشِكَ
Translation: All that is beneath Your throne humbles itself before Your greatness

Arabic text: وَ انْقَادَ لِلتَّسْلِيمِ لَكَ كُلُّ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And all Your creation yields to submission to You

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا تُحَسُّ وَ لَا تُجَسُّ وَ لَا تُمَسُّ
Translation: Glory be to You! You cannot be sensed, felt, or touched

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُكَادُ وَ لَا تُمَاطُ وَ لَا تُنَازَعُ وَ لَا تُجَارَى
Translation: You cannot be deceived, eluded, disputed, rivaled

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُمَارَى وَ لَا تُخَادَعُ وَ لَا تُمَاكَرُ
Translation: Or contended with, outwitted, or outmaneuvered

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ سَبِيلُكَ جَدَدٌ وَ أَمْرُكَ رَشَدٌ وَ أَنْتَ حَيٌّ صَمَدٌ
Translation: Glory be to You! Your path is direct, Your command is guidance, and You are the Ever-Living, Self-Subsisting

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ قَوْلُكَ حُكْمٌ وَ قَضَاؤُكَ حَتْمٌ وَ إِرَادَتُكَ عَزْمٌ
Translation: Glory be to You! Your word is judgment, Your decree is inevitable, and Your will is determination

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا رَادَّ لِمَشِيَّتِكَ وَ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! None can repel Your will and none can change Your words

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ بَاهِرَ الْآيَاتِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بَارِئَ النَّسَمَاتِ
Translation: Glory be to You! Manifest in signs, Originator of the heavens, Creator of souls

Arabic text: لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ
Translation: To You belongs praise that lasts as long as You last

Arabic text: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا خَالِدًا بِنِعْمَتِكَ
Translation: And to You belongs praise that is eternal with Your blessing

Arabic text: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يُوَازِيْ صُنْعَكَ
Translation: And to You belongs praise that equals Your creation

Arabic text: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاكَ
Translation: And to You belongs praise that exceeds Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا مَعَ حَمْدِ كُلِّ حَامِدٍ
Translation: And to You belongs praise along with the praise of every praiser

Arabic text: وَ شُكْرًا يَقْصُرُ عَنْهُ شُكْرُ كُلِّ شَاكِرٍ
Translation: And thanks that falls short of the thanks of every thankful one

Arabic text: حَمْدًا لَا يَنْبَغِيْ إِلَّا لَكَ
Translation: Praise that befits none but You

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And is offered to none but You

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يُسْتَدَامُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُ
Translation: Praise by which the first is sustained

Arabic text: وَ يُسْتَدْعَى بِهِ دَوَامُ الْآخِرِ
Translation: And the continuance of the last is sought

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَتَضَاعَفُ عَلَى كُرُورِ الْأَزْمِنَةِ
Translation: Praise that multiplies through the passing of ages

Arabic text: وَ يَتَزَايَدُ أَضْعَافًا مُتَرَادِفَةً
Translation: And increases in successive multitudes

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَعْجِزُ عَنْ إِحْصَائِهِ الْحَفَظَةُ
Translation: Praise that the recording angels cannot enumerate

Arabic text: وَ يَزِيدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْصَتْهُ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ الْكَتَبَةُ
Translation: And exceeds what the scribes have recorded in Your Book

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يُوَازِنُ عَرْشَكَ الْمَجِيدَ
Translation: Praise that balances Your Glorious Throne

Arabic text: وَ يُعَادِلُ كُرْسِيَّكَ الرَّفِيعَ
Translation: And equals Your Elevated Chair

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَكْمُلُ لَدَيْكَ ثَوَابُهُ
Translation: Praise whose reward is complete with You

Arabic text: وَ يَسْتَغْرِقُ كُلَّ جَزَاءٍ جَزَاؤُهُ
Translation: And whose recompense exhausts all other recompense

Arabic text: حَمْدًا ظَاهِرُهُ وَفْقٌ لِبَاطِنِهِ
Translation: Praise whose outward conforms to its inward

Arabic text: وَ بَاطِنُهُ وَفْقٌ لِصِدْقِ النِّيَّةِ
Translation: And whose inward conforms to sincere intention

Arabic text: حَمْدًا لَمْ يَحْمَدْكَ خَلْقٌ مِثْلَهُ
Translation: Praise with which no created being has praised You before

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَعْرِفُ أَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ فَضْلَهُ
Translation: And whose excellence none knows besides You

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يُعَانُ مَنِ اجْتَهَدَ فِيْ تَعْدِيْدِهِ
Translation: Praise in which whoever strives to enumerate is supported

Arabic text: وَ يُؤَيَّدُ مَنْ أَغْرَقَ نَزْعًا فِيْ تَوْفِيَتِهِ
Translation: And whoever draws deeply into its exhaustion is assisted

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَجْمَعُ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْحَمْدِ
Translation: Praise that combines all praise You have created

Arabic text: وَ يَنْتَظِمُ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ بَعْدُ
Translation: And organizes what You will create thereafter

Arabic text: حَمْدًا لَا حَمْدَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى قَوْلِكَ مِنْهُ
Translation: Praise closer to Your word than any other praise

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَحْمَدَ مِمَّنْ يَحْمَدُكَ بِهِ
Translation: And of which none is more praiseworthy than he who praises You with it

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يُوجِبُ بِكَرَمِكَ الْمَزِيدَ بِوُفُورِهِ
Translation: Praise which through Your generosity incites abundant increase

Arabic text: وَ تَصِلُهُ بِمَزِيدٍ بَعْدَ مَزِيدٍ طَوْلًا مِنْكَ
Translation: And which You connect with more and more of Your bounty

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَجِبُ لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ وَ يُقَابِلُ عِزَّ جَلَالِكَ
Translation: Praise that befits the generosity of Your face and meets the might of Your majesty

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: My Lord, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْمُنْتَجَبِ الْمُصْطَفَى
Translation: The chosen, the selected one

Arabic text: اَلْمُكَرَّمِ الْمُقَرَّبِ أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ
Translation: The honored, the near one, with the best of Your blessings

Arabic text: وَ بَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ أَتَمَّ بَرَكَاتِكَ
Translation: And bestow upon him the most perfect of Your benedictions

Arabic text: وَ تَرَحَّمْ عَلَيْهِ أَمْتَعَ رَحَمَاتِكَ
Translation: And have mercy upon him with the most enjoyable of Your mercies

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ صَلَاةً زَاكِيَةً
Translation: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his family with a blessing that is pure

Arabic text: لَا تَكُونُ صَلَاةٌ أَزْكَى مِنْهَا
Translation: With no blessing purer than it

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً نَامِيَةً
Translation: And bless him with a blessing that increases

Arabic text: لَا تَكُونُ صَلَاةٌ أَنْمَى مِنْهَا
Translation: With no blessing increasing more than it

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً رَاضِيَةً
Translation: And bless him with a blessing that pleases

Arabic text: لَا تَكُونُ صَلَاةٌ فَوْقَهَا
Translation: With no blessing beyond it

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تُرْضِيهِ وَ تَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاهُ
Translation: With a blessing that pleases him and exceeds his pleasure

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَ تَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاكَ لَهُ
Translation: And bless him with a blessing that pleases You and exceeds Your pleasure for him

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً لَا تَرْضَى لَهُ إِلَّا بِهَا
Translation: And bless him with a blessing that You see he deserves only through it

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَرَى غَيْرَهُ لَهَا أَهْلًا
Translation: And no one else deserves it

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تُجَاوِزُ رِضْوَانَكَ وَ يَتَّصِلُ اتِّصَالُهَا بِبَقَائِكَ
Translation: With a blessing that surpasses Your pleasure and its continuance connects with Your eternity

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَنْفَدُ كَمَا لَا تَنْفَدُ كَلِمَاتُكَ
Translation: And does not expire, just as Your words do not expire

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تَنْتَظِمُ صَلَوَاتِ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: With a blessing that encompasses the blessings of Your angels

Arabic text: وَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ وَ أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: Your prophets, Your messengers, and those who obey You

Arabic text: وَ تَشْتَمِلُ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: And comprises the blessings of Your servants

Arabic text: مِنْ جِنِّكَ وَ إِنْسِكَ وَ أَهْلِ إِجَابَتِكَ
Translation: From among Your jinn and mankind and those who answer Your call

Arabic text: وَ تَجْتَمِعُ عَلَى صَلَاةِ كُلِّ مَنْ ذَرَأْتَ وَ بَرَأْتَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And gathers together the blessings of every being You have created and formed of all Your creation

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: My Lord, bless him and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تُحِيطُ بِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ سَالِفَةٍ وَ مُسْتَأْنَفَةٍ
Translation: With a blessing that encompasses every blessing, past and future

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَى آلِهِ
Translation: And bless him and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً مَرْضِيَّةً لَكَ وَ لِمَنْ دُونَكَ
Translation: With a blessing that is pleasing to You and to all below You

Arabic text: وَ تُنْشِئُ مَعَ ذٰلِكَ صَلَوَاتٍ تُضَاعِفُ مَعَهَا تِلْكَ الصَّلَوَاتِ عِنْدَهَا
Translation: And create along with that blessings that multiply those blessings

Arabic text: وَ تَزِيدُهَا عَلَى كُرُورِ الْأَيَّامِ زِيَادَةً
Translation: And increase them through the passing of days with an increase

Arabic text: فِيْ تَضَاعِيفَ لَا يَعُدُّهَا غَيْرُكَ
Translation: In multiples that none can count but You

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى أَطَائِبِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
Translation: My Lord, bless the pure members of his household

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ اخْتَرْتَهُمْ لِأَمْرِكَ
Translation: Whom You have chosen for Your command

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلْتَهُمْ خَزَنَةَ عِلْمِكَ وَ حَفَظَةَ دِينِكَ
Translation: And made them the treasurers of Your knowledge and guardians of Your religion

Arabic text: وَ خُلَفَاءَكَ فِيْ أَرْضِكَ وَ حُجَجَكَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ
Translation: Your vicegerents on Your earth and Your proofs over Your servants

Arabic text: وَ طَهَّرْتَهُمْ مِنَ الرِّجْسِ وَ الدَّنَسِ تَطْهِيرًا بِإِرَادَتِكَ
Translation: And whom You have purified from impurity and filth by Your will

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيْلَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ الْمَسْلَكَ إِلَى جَنَّتِكَ
Translation: And made them the means to You and the path to Your paradise

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تُجْزِلُ لَهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ نِحَلِكَ وَ كَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: With a blessing that increases for them Your gifts and generosity

Arabic text: وَ تُكْمِلُ لَهُمُ الْأَشْيَاءَ مِنْ عَطَايَاكَ وَ نَوَافِلِكَ
Translation: And perfects for them Your bestowals and awards

Arabic text: وَ تُوَفِّرُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَظَّ مِنْ عَوَائِدِكَ وَ فَوَائِدِكَ
Translation: And fulfills for them Your share of gifts and benefits

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً لَا أَمَدَ فِيْ أَوَّلِهَا
Translation: My Lord, bless him and them with a blessing with no limit to its beginning

Arabic text: وَ لَا غَايَةَ لِأَمَدِهَا وَ لَا نِهَايَةَ لِآخِرِهَا
Translation: No bound to its term, and no end to its last

Arabic text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَ مَا دُونَهُ
Translation: My Lord, bless them to the weight of Your throne and what is below it

Arabic text: وَ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَ مَا فَوْقَهُنَّ
Translation: To the fill of Your heavens and what is above them

Arabic text: وَ عَدَدَ أَرَضِيكَ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ
Translation: To the number of Your earths and what is below and between them

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تُقَرِّبُهُمْ مِنْكَ زُلْفَى وَ تَكُونُ لَكَ وَ لَهُمْ رِضًى
Translation: A blessing that brings them near to You in proximity and becomes a pleasure for You and them

Arabic text: وَ مُتَّصِلَةً بِنَظَائِرِهِنَّ أَبَدًا
Translation: And connected with their like forever

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَيَّدْتَ دِيْنَكَ فِيْ كُلِّ أَوَانٍ
Translation: O Allah, You have supported Your religion in every era

Arabic text: بِإِمَامٍ أَقَمْتَهُ عَلَمًا لِعِبَادِكَ وَ مَنَارًا فِيْ بِلَادِكَ
Translation: With an Imam whom You appointed as a standard for Your servants and a beacon in Your lands

Arabic text: بَعْدَ أَنْ وَصَلْتَ حَبْلَهُ بِحَبْلِكَ
Translation: After You connected his cord to Your cord

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلْتَهُ الذَّرِيْعَةَ إِلَى رِضْوَانِكَ
Translation: And made him the means to Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ افْتَرَضْتَ طَاعَتَهُ وَ حَذَّرْتَ مَعْصِيَتَهُ
Translation: And made obedience to him obligatory and warned against disobeying him

Arabic text: وَ أَمَرْتَ بِامْتِثَالِ أَوَامِرِهِ وَ الِانْتِهَاءِ عِنْدَ نَهْيِهِ
Translation: And commanded the execution of his commands and to stop at his prohibitions

Arabic text: وَ أَلَّا يَتَقَدَّمَهُ مُتَقَدِّمٌ وَ لَا يَتَأَخَّرَ عَنْهُ مُتَأَخِّرٌ فَهُوَ عِصْمَةُ اللَّائِذِينَ
Translation: And that no one should precede him or fall behind him. He is the protection of those who seek refuge

Arabic text: وَ كَهْفُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ عُرْوَةُ الْمُتَمَسِّكِينَ وَ بَهَاءُ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: The shelter of believers, the firm handle of those who grasp, and the radiance for the worlds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَوْزِعْ لِوَلِيِّكَ شُكْرَ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: O Allah, inspire Your guardian to give thanks for what You have bestowed upon him

Arabic text: وَ أَوْزِعْنَا مِثْلَهُ فِيهِ وَ آتِهِ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا
Translation: And inspire us with the same concerning him, and grant him from You a supporting authority

Arabic text: وَ افْتَحْ لَهُ فَتْحًا يَسِيرًا وَ أَعِنْهُ بِرُكْنِكَ الْأَعَزِّ
Translation: Open for him an easy opening, aid him with Your mightiest pillar

Arabic text: وَ اشْدُدْ أَزْرَهُ وَ قَوِّ عَضُدَهُ وَ رَاعِهِ بِعَيْنِكَ
Translation: Strengthen his back, fortify his arm, and guard him with Your eye

Arabic text: وَ احْمِهِ بِحِفْظِكَ وَ انْصُرْهُ بِمَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: Protect him with Your safeguarding, help him with Your angels

Arabic text: وَ امْدُدْهُ بِجُنْدِكَ الْأَغْلَبِ وَ أَقِمْ بِهِ كِتَابَكَ وَ حُدُودَكَ
Translation: Support him with Your victorious army, and establish through him Your Book, Your bounds

Arabic text: وَ شَرَائِعَكَ وَ سُنَنَ رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Your laws, and the practices of Your Messenger, Your blessings upon him and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَحْيِ بِهِ مَا أَمَاتَهُ الظَّالِمُوْنَ مِنْ مَعَالِمِ دِينِكَ
Translation: Revive through him what oppressors have killed of Your religion's teachings

Arabic text: وَ اجْلُ بِهِ صَدَأَ الْجَوْرِ عَنْ طَرِيقَتِكَ
Translation: Polish through him the rust of injustice from Your way

Arabic text: وَ أَبِنْ بِهِ الضَّرَّاءَ مِنْ سَبِيلِكَ
Translation: Eliminate through him hardship from Your path

Arabic text: وَ أَزِلْ بِهِ النَّاكِبِينَ عَنْ صِرَاطِكَ
Translation: Remove through him those who deviate from Your road

Arabic text: وَ امْحَقْ بِهِ بُغَاةَ قَصْدِكَ عِوَجًا
Translation: Eradicate through him those who seek crookedness in Your path

Arabic text: وَ أَلِنْ جَانِبَهُ لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ وَ ابْسُطْ يَدَهُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِكَ
Translation: Make his side gentle toward Your friends, and extend his hand over Your enemies

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لَنَا رَأْفَتَهُ وَ رَحْمَتَهُ وَ تَعَطُّفَهُ وَ تَحَنُّنَهُ
Translation: Give us his compassion, his mercy, his tenderness, and his sympathy

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْنَا لَهُ سَامِعِينَ مُطِيعِينَ وَ فِيْ رِضَاهُ سَاعِينَ
Translation: Make us his hearers and obeyers, strivers toward his pleasure

Arabic text: وَ إِلَى نُصْرَتِهِ وَ الْمُدَافَعَةِ عَنْهُ مُكْنِفِينَ
Translation: Defenders and protectors of him in his support

Arabic text: وَ إِلَيْكَ وَ إِلَى رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ
Translation: And bringing us near through that to You and to Your Messenger

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِذٰلِكَ مُتَقَرِّبِينَ
Translation: Your blessings, O Allah, be upon him and his family

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى أَوْلِيَائِهِمُ الْمُعْتَرِفِينَ بِمَقَامِهِمْ
Translation: O Allah, bless their allies who acknowledge their status

Arabic text: اَلْمُتَّبِعِينَ مَنْهَجَهُمُ الْمُقْتَفِينَ آثَارَهُمْ
Translation: Who follow their way, pursue their tracks

Arabic text: اَلْمُسْتَمْسِكِينَ بِعُرْوَتِهِمُ الْمُتَمَسِّكِينَ بِوَلَايَتِهِمْ
Translation: Hold fast to their handle, adhere to their guardianship

Arabic text: اَلْمُؤْتَمِّينَ بِإِمَامَتِهِمُ الْمُسَلِّمِيْنَ لِأَمْرِهِمْ
Translation: Follow their leadership, submit to their command

Arabic text: اَلْمُجْتَهِدِيْنَ فِيْ طَاعَتِهِمُ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ أَيَّامَهُمْ
Translation: Strive in their obedience, await their days

Arabic text: اَلْمَادِّينَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْيُنَهُمْ
Translation: Direct their eyes toward them

Arabic text: اَلصَّلَوَاتِ الْمُبَارَكَاتِ الزَّاكِيَاتِ النَّامِيَاتِ الْغَادِيَاتِ الرَّائِحَاتِ
Translation: With blessings blessed, pure, growing, increasing in morning and evening

Arabic text: وَ سَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ عَلَى أَرْوَاحِهِمْ
Translation: And grant them and their spirits peace

Arabic text: وَ اجْمَعْ عَلَى التَّقْوَى أَمْرَهُمْ
Translation: Unite their affairs in piety

Arabic text: وَ أَصْلِحْ لَهُمْ شُؤُونَهُمْ
Translation: Improve their condition

Arabic text: وَ تُبْ عَلَيْهِمْ
Translation: Accept their repentance

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ
Translation: Surely You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful, and the Best of forgivers

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مَعَهُمْ فِيْ دَارِ السَّلَامِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: And place us with them in the Abode of Peace, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ هَذَا يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ
Translation: O Allah, this is the Day of Arafah

Arabic text: يَوْمٌ شَرَّفْتَهُ وَ كَرَّمْتَهُ وَ عَظَّمْتَهُ نَشَرْتَ فِيهِ رَحْمَتَكَ
Translation: A day which You have made noble, honored, and exalted. You have spread Your mercy in it

Arabic text: وَ مَنَنْتَ فِيهِ بِعَفْوِكَ وَ أَجْزَلْتَ فِيهِ عَطِيَّتَكَ
Translation: Bestowed Your pardon through it, and made plentiful Your giving

Arabic text: وَ تَفَضَّلْتَ بِهِ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ
Translation: And graciously favored Your servants with it

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ أَنَا عَبْدُكَ الَّذِيْ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ خَلْقِكَ لَهُ وَ بَعْدَ خَلْقِكَ إِيَّاهُ
Translation: O Allah, I am Your servant whom You have blessed before creating him and after creating him

Arabic text: فَجَعَلْتَهُ مِمَّنْ هَدَيْتَهُ لِدِينِكَ
Translation: You made him among those whom You have guided to Your religion

Arabic text: وَ وَفَّقْتَهُ لِحَقِّكَ وَ عَصَمْتَهُ بِحَبْلِكَ
Translation: Granted him success in fulfilling Your right, and protected him with Your cord

Arabic text: وَ أَدْخَلْتَهُ فِيْ حِزْبِكَ وَ أَرْشَدْتَهُ لِمُوَالَاةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
Translation: Included him in Your party, and directed him to befriend Your friends

Arabic text: وَ مُعَادَاةِ أَعْدَائِكَ ثُمَّ أَمَرْتَهُ فَلَمْ يَأْتَمِرْ
Translation: And to show enmity to Your enemies. Then You commanded him, but he did not follow Your command

Arabic text: وَ زَجَرْتَهُ فَلَمْ يَنْزَجِرْ وَ نَهَيْتَهُ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ فَخَالَفَ أَمْرَكَ إِلَى نَهْيِكَ
Translation: You prohibited him, but he did not heed, and You forbade him from disobedience to You, but he opposed Your command to Your prohibition

Arabic text: لَا مُعَانَدَةً لَكَ وَ لَا اسْتِكْبَارًا عَلَيْكَ
Translation: Not in defiance of You, nor to display arrogance toward You

Arabic text: بَلْ دَعَاهُ هَوَاهُ إِلَى مَا زَيَّلْتَهُ وَ إِلَى مَا حَذَّرْتَهُ
Translation: But his desires called him to that which You had set apart and warned against

Arabic text: وَ أَعَانَهُ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ عَدُوُّكَ وَ عَدُوُّهُ
Translation: And he was helped to that by Your enemy and his enemy

Arabic text: فَأَقْدَمَ عَلَيْهِ عَارِفًا بِوَعِيدِكَ رَاجِيًا لِعَفْوِكَ
Translation: So he went forward toward it, knowing Your threat, hoping for Your pardon

Arabic text: وَاثِقًا بِتَجَاوُزِكَ وَ كَانَ أَحَقَّ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: Relying on Your forgiveness, and he was the most worthy of Your servants

Arabic text: مَعَ مَا مَنَنْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَلَّا يَفْعَلَ
Translation: With all that You had bestowed upon him, not to do so

Arabic text: وَ هَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ صَاغِرًا
Translation: And here I am before You, humbled

Arabic text: ذَلِيْلًا خَاضِعًا خَاشِعًا خَائِفًا
Translation: Lowly, submissive, fearful

Arabic text: مُعْتَرِفًا بِعَظِيمٍ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَحَمَّلْتُهُ
Translation: Confessing the terrible sins I have borne

Arabic text: وَ جَلِيلٍ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا اجْتَرَمْتُهُ
Translation: And the great offenses that I have committed

Arabic text: مُسْتَجِيرًا بِصَفْحِكَ لَائِذًا بِرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Seeking refuge in Your forgiveness, taking shelter in Your mercy

Arabic text: مُوقِنًا أَنَّهُ لَا يُجِيرُنِيْ مِنْكَ مُجِيرٌ
Translation: Certain that no one can protect me from You

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَمْنَعُنِيْ مِنْكَ مَانِعٌ
Translation: And no one can shield me from You

Arabic text: فَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا تَعُودُ بِهِ عَلَى مَنِ اقْتَرَفَ مِنْ تَغَمُّدِكَ
Translation: So bestow upon me what You bestow on one who commits evil in Your covering

Arabic text: وَ جُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا تَجُودُ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَلْقَى بِيَدِهِ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: And be generous to me as You are generous to one who throws himself before You in Your pardon

Arabic text: وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا لَا يَتَعَاظَمُكَ
Translation: And favor me with what is not too great for You

Arabic text: أَنْ تَمُنَّ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَمَّلَكَ مِنْ غُفْرَانِكَ
Translation: To favor one who asks You for forgiveness

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ نَصِيبًا أَنَالُ بِهِ حَظًّا مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ
Translation: And grant me on this day a share by which I may attain a portion of Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَرُدَّنِيْ صِفْرًا مِمَّا يَنْقَلِبُ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدُوْنَ لَكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: And do not send me away empty-handed of what Your worshippers gain from Your servants

Arabic text: وَ إِنِّيْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ أُقَدِّمْ مَا قَدَّمُوهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ
Translation: And although I have not put forward the good deeds they have offered

Arabic text: فَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ تَوْحِيدَكَ
Translation: I have put forward Your unity

Arabic text: وَ نَفْيَ الْأَضْدَادِ وَ الْأَنْدَادِ وَ الْأَشْبَاهِ عَنْكَ
Translation: And the denial of opposites, rivals, and likenesses to You

Arabic text: وَ أَتَيْتُكَ مِنَ الْأَبْوَابِ الَّتِيْ أَمَرْتَ أَنْ تُؤْتَى مِنْهَا
Translation: And I have come to You by the gates You have commanded to be approached

Arabic text: وَ تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْكَ بِمَا لَا يَقْرُبُ
Translation: And I have sought nearness to You with that which none comes near

Arabic text: أَحَدٌ مِنْكَ إِلَّا بِالتَّقَرُّبِ بِهِ
Translation: Except by seeking nearness through it

Arabic text: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعْتُ ذٰلِكَ بِالْإِنَابَةِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Then I followed that with repentance to You

Arabic text: وَ التَّذَلُّلِ وَ الِاسْتِكَانَةِ لَكَ وَ حُسْنِ الظَّنِّ بِكَ وَ الثِّقَةِ بِمَا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Humbleness, submission, good opinion of You, and trust in what is with You

Arabic text: وَ شَفَعْتُهُ بِرَجَائِكَ
Translation: And I coupled it with hope in You

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ قَلَّ مَا يَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ رَاجِيكَ
Translation: Which rarely disappoints the one who hopes in You

Arabic text: وَ سَأَلْتُكَ مَسْأَلَةَ الْحَقِيرِ الذَّلِيلِ
Translation: And I asked You the asking of one lowly, abased

Arabic text: اَلْبَائِسِ الْفَقِيرِ الْخَائِفِ الْمُسْتَجِيرِ
Translation: Poor, fearful, seeking protection

Arabic text: وَ مَعَ ذٰلِكَ خِيفَةً وَ تَضَرُّعًا وَ تَعَوُّذًا وَ تَلَوُّذًا
Translation: And along with that, fearful, seeking refuge, anxious, taking shelter

Arabic text: لَا مُسْتَطِيلًا بِتَكَبُّرِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
Translation: Not presumptuous through the pride of the proud

Arabic text: وَ لَا مُتَعَالِيًا بِدَالَّةِ الْمُطِيعِينَ
Translation: Nor exalting myself with the boldness of the obedient

Arabic text: وَ لَا مُسْتَطِيلًا بِشَفَاعَةِ الشَّافِعِينَ
Translation: Nor claiming intercession of intercessors

Arabic text: وَ أَنَا بَعْدُ أَقَلُّ الْأَقَلِّينَ وَ أَذَلُّ الْأَذَلِّينَ
Translation: Yet I am still the least of the least and the lowest of the low

Arabic text: وَ مِثْلُ الذَّرَّةِ أَوْ دُونَهَا
Translation: Like an atom or even less

Arabic text: فَيَا مَنْ لَمْ يُعَاجِلِ الْمُسِيئِينَ وَ لَا يَنْدَهُ الْمُتْرَفِينَ
Translation: O He who does not hasten the punishment of evildoers nor disdain those who live in luxury

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يَمُنُّ بِإِقَالَةِ الْعَاثِرِينَ وَ يَتَفَضَّلُ بِإِنْظَارِ الْخَاطِئِينَ
Translation: O He who shows favor by helping those who stumble and is gracious in respiting sinners

Arabic text: أَنَا الْمُسِيءُ الْمُعْتَرِفُ الْخَاطِئُ الْعَاثِرُ
Translation: I am the evildoer, the confessor, the sinner, the stumbler

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ أَقْدَمَ عَلَيْكَ مُجْتَرِئًا
Translation: I am the one who approached You deliberately

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ عَصَاكَ مُتَعَمِّدًا
Translation: I am the one who disobeyed You intentionally

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ اسْتَخْفَى مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَ بَارَزَكَ
Translation: I am the one who hid from Your servants and confronted You

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ هَابَ عِبَادَكَ وَ أَمِنَكَ
Translation: I am the one who dreaded Your servants but felt secure from You

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَرْهَبْ سَطْوَتَكَ وَ لَمْ يَخَفْ بَأْسَكَ
Translation: I am the one who did not dread Your severity and did not fear Your punishment

Arabic text: أَنَا الْجَانِيْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَنَا الْمُرْتَهَنُ بِبَلِيَّتِهِ
Translation: I am the offender against myself, I am the one hostage to his affliction

Arabic text: أَنَا الْقَلِيلُ الْحَيَاءِ أَنَا الطَّوِيلُ الْعَنَاءِ
Translation: I am the one with little shame, I am the one suffering prolonged distress

Arabic text: بِحَقِّ مَنِ انْتَجَبْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: By the right of the one whom You have chosen from Your creation

Arabic text: وَ بِمَنِ اصْطَفَيْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ
Translation: And by the one whom You have selected for Yourself

Arabic text: بِحَقِّ مَنِ اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِكَ وَ مَنِ اجْتَبَيْتَ لِشَأْنِكَ
Translation: By the right of the one whom You have chosen from Your creation and whom You have elected for Your task

Arabic text: بِحَقِّ مَنْ وَصَلْتَ طَاعَتَهُ بِطَاعَتِكَ
Translation: By the right of the one whose obedience You have linked to Your obedience

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ جَعَلْتَ مَعْصِيَتَهُ كَمَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And whose disobedience You have made like disobedience to You

Arabic text: بِحَقِّ مَنْ قَرَنْتَ مُوَالَاتَهُ بِمُوَالَاتِكَ
Translation: By the right of the one whose loyalty You have connected to Your loyalty

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ نُطْتَ مُعَادَاتَهُ بِمُعَادَاتِكَ
Translation: And whose enmity You have linked to Your enmity

Arabic text: تَغَمَّدْنِيْ فِيْ يَوْمِيْ هَذَا بِمَا تَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ مَنْ جَارَ إِلَيْكَ مُتَنَصِّلًا
Translation: Cover me on this day with what You cover one who sincerely seeks Your pardon

Arabic text: وَ عَاذَ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ تَائِبًا
Translation: And who seeks refuge in Your forgiveness repentantly

Arabic text: وَ تَوَلَّنِيْ بِمَا تَتَوَلَّى بِهِ أَهْلَ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And attend to me as You attend to the people of Your obedience

Arabic text: وَ الزُّلْفَى لَدَيْكَ وَ الْمَكَانَةِ مِنْكَ
Translation: Nearness to You, and rank with You

Arabic text: وَ تَوَحَّدْنِيْ بِمَا تَتَوَحَّدُ بِهِ مَنْ وَفَى بِعَهْدِكَ
Translation: And single me out as You single out one who fulfills Your covenant

Arabic text: وَ أَتْعَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِيْ ذَاتِكَ وَ أَجْهَدَهَا فِيْ مَرْضَاتِكَ
Translation: And fatigues himself for Your sake and exerts himself in Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِيْ بِتَفْرِيطِيْ فِيْ جَنْبِكَ
Translation: Do not take me to task for my neglect in Your right

Arabic text: وَ تَعَدِّيْ طَوْرِيْ فِيْ حُدُودِكَ وَ مُجَاوَزَةِ أَحْكَامِكَ
Translation: My transgression of Your bounds, and stepping outside Your ordinances

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَسْتَدْرِجْنِيْ بِإِمْلَائِكَ لِي
Translation: And do not draw me on with Your respite

Arabic text: اِسْتِدْرَاجَ مَنْ مَنَعَنِيْ خَيْرَ مَا عِنْدَهُ
Translation: Like one You have deprived of good from himself

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَشْرَكْكَ فِيْ حُلُوْلِ نِعْمَتِهِ بِي
Translation: And has not shared You in the coming of Your blessing to him

Arabic text: وَ نَبِّهْنِيْ مِنْ رَقْدَةِ الْغَافِلِينَ
Translation: And awaken me from the slumber of the heedless

Arabic text: وَ سِنَةِ الْمُسْرِفِينَ وَ نَعْسَةِ الْمَخْذُولِينَ
Translation: The waste of the extravagant, and the sleep of the forsaken

Arabic text: وَ خُذْ بِقَلْبِيْ إِلَى مَا اسْتَعْمَلْتَ بِهِ الْقَانِتِينَ
Translation: And take my heart to that which You have employed the devoted

Arabic text: وَ اسْتَعْبَدْتَ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدِيْنَ وَ اسْتَنْقَذْتَ بِهِ الْمُتَهَاوِنِيْنَ
Translation: And engaged the worshippers, and rescued the neglectful

Arabic text: وَ أَعِذْنِيْ مِمَّا يُبَاعِدُنِيْ عَنْكَ
Translation: And protect me from that which distances me from You

Arabic text: وَ يَحُولُ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَ حَظِّيْ مِنْكَ
Translation: And comes between me and my share from You

Arabic text: وَ يَصُدُّنِيْ عَمَّا أُحَاوِلُ لَدَيْكَ
Translation: And hinders me from what I seek from You

Arabic text: وَ سَهِّلْ لِيْ مَسْلَكَ الْخَيْرَاتِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Make easy for me the path of good works toward You

Arabic text: وَ الْمُسَابَقَةِ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتَ
Translation: Racing toward them from where You have commanded

Arabic text: وَ الْمُشَاحَّةَ فِيهَا عَلَى مَا أَرَدْتَ
Translation: And striving toward them as You desire

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَمْحَقْنِيْ فِيمَنْ تَمْحَقُ مِنَ الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِمَا أَوْعَدْتَ
Translation: Do not crush me among those whom You crush from those who take lightly what You have promised

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ مَعَ مَنْ تُهْلِكُ مِنَ الْمُتَعَرِّضِينَ لِمَقْتِكَ
Translation: And do not destroy me with those whom You destroy from those who expose themselves to Your hatred

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُتَبِّرْنِيْ فِيمَنْ تُتَبِّرُ مِنَ الْمُنْحَرِفِينَ عَنْ سُبُلِكَ
Translation: And do not annihilate me among those whom You annihilate from those who deviate from Your paths

Arabic text: وَ نَجِّنِيْ مِنْ غَمَرَاتِ الْفِتْنَةِ
Translation: Deliver me from the floods of trial

Arabic text: وَ خَلِّصْنِيْ مِنْ لَهَوَاتِ الْبَلْوَى
Translation: Save me from the depths of affliction

Arabic text: وَ أَجِرْنِيْ مِنْ أَخْذِ الْإِمْلَاءِ
Translation: And protect me from being seized by respite

Arabic text: وَ حُلْ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَ عَدُوٍّ يُضِلُّنِي
Translation: Come between me and the enemy who misguides me

Arabic text: وَ هَوًى يُوبِقُنِيْ وَ مَنْقَصَةٍ تَرْهَقُنِي
Translation: The passion that ruins me, and the deficiency that overcomes me

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُعْرِضْ عَنِّيْ إِعْرَاضَ مَنْ لَا تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بَعْدَ غَضَبِكَ
Translation: Do not turn away from me with the turning away of one with whom You are not pleased after Your anger

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُؤْيِسْنِيْ مِنَ الْأَمَلِ فِيكَ فَيَغْلِبَ عَلَيَّ الْقُنُوطُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Do not make me lose hope in You, so that despair of Your mercy overtakes me

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَمْنَحْنِيْ بِمَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِيْ بِهِ
Translation: Do not grant me that which I cannot bear

Arabic text: فَتَبْهَظَنِيْ مِمَّا تُحَمِّلُنِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِ مَحَبَّتِكَ
Translation: So that it burdens me with what You load upon me of Your love

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُرْسِلْنِيْ مِنْ يَدِكَ إِرْسَالَ مَنْ لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ
Translation: Do not cast me away with the casting of one in whom there is no good

Arabic text: وَ لَا حَاجَةَ بِكَ إِلَيْهِ وَ لَا إِنَابَةَ لَهُ
Translation: Nor need for, nor turning back in repentance

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَرْمِ بِيْ رَمْيَ مَنْ سَقَطَ مِنْ عَيْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ
Translation: Do not fling me with the flinging of one who has fallen from Your eye

Arabic text: وَ مَنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْخِزْيُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
Translation: And on whom disgrace has come down from You

Arabic text: بَلْ خُذْ بِيَدِيْ مِنْ سَقْطَةِ الْمُتَرَدِّدِيْنَ
Translation: Rather take my hand from the failing of the perplexed

Arabic text: وَ وَهْلَةِ الْمُتَعَسِّفِينَ وَ زَلَّةِ الْمَغْرُورِينَ وَ وَرْطَةِ الْهَالِكِينَ
Translation: The confusion of the misguided, the slip of the deceived, and the plight of the destroyed

Arabic text: وَ عَافِنِيْ مِمَّا ابْتَلَيْتَ بِهِ طَبَقَاتِ عَبِيدِكَ وَ إِمَائِكَ
Translation: Save me from that with which You have afflicted the ranks of Your servants and maidens

Arabic text: وَ بَلِّغْنِيْ مَبَالِغَ مَنْ عُنِيتَ بِهِ وَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُ
Translation: And make me reach the ranks of those whom You have attended to, blessed, and been pleased with

Arabic text: فَأَعَشْتَهُ حَمِيدًا وَ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ سَعِيدًا
Translation: So You have made them live as praiseworthy and die as felicitous

Arabic text: وَ طَوِّقْنِيْ طَوْقَ الْإِقْلَاعِ عَمَّا يُحْبِطُ الْحَسَنَاتِ
Translation: Encircle me with the collar of abstaining from that which nullifies good works

Arabic text: وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالْبَرَكَاتِ
Translation: And takes away blessings

Arabic text: وَ أَشْعِرْ قَلْبِيَ الِازْدِجَارَ عَنْ قَبَائِحِ السَّيِّئَاتِ
Translation: Fill my heart with restraint from the ugly deeds of offenses

Arabic text: وَ فَوَاضِحِ الْحَوْبَاتِ
Translation: And disgraceful sins

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَشْغَلْنِيْ بِمَا لَا أُدْرِكُهُ إِلَّا بِكَ عَمَّا لَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّيْ غَيْرُهُ
Translation: Do not occupy me with what I cannot reach except through You, from what does not please You

Arabic text: وَ انْزِعْ مِنْ قَلْبِيْ حُبَّ دُنْيَا دَنِيَّةٍ تَنْهَى عَمَّا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Remove from my heart the love of this base world that prevents what is with You

Arabic text: وَ تَصُدُّ عَنِ ابْتِغَاءِ الْوَسِيْلَةِ إِلَيْكَ وَ تُذْهِلُ عَنِ التَّقَرُّبِ مِنْكَ
Translation: And blocks seeking means to You, and distracts from striving toward You

Arabic text: وَ زَيِّنْ لِيَ التَّفَرُّدَ بِمُنَاجَاتِكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ
Translation: Make attractive to me solitary prayer to You by night and day

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لِيْ عِصْمَةً تُدْنِينِيْ مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ
Translation: Grant me protection that brings me close to fear of You

Arabic text: وَ تَقْطَعُنِيْ عَنْ رُكُوبِ مَحَارِمِكَ
Translation: And cuts me off from riding into forbidden things

Arabic text: وَ تَفُكَّنِيْ مِنْ أَسْرِ الْعَظَائِمِ
Translation: And frees me from the captivity of great sins

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لِيَ التَّطْهِيرَ مِنْ دَنَسِ الْعِصْيَانِ
Translation: Give me purification from the defilement of disobedience

Arabic text: وَ أَذْهِبْ عَنِّيْ دَرَنَ الْخَطَايَا
Translation: Take away from me the filth of offenses

Arabic text: وَ سَرْبِلْنِيْ بِسِرْبَالِ عَافِيَتِكَ
Translation: Clothe me in the robe of Your well-being

Arabic text: وَ رَدِّنِيْ رِدَاءَ مُعَافَاتِكَ
Translation: Wrap me in the cloak of Your protection

Arabic text: وَ جَلِّلْنِيْ سَوَابِغَ نَعْمَائِكَ
Translation: Dress me in Your abundant favors

Arabic text: وَ ظَاهِرْ لَدَيَّ فَضْلَكَ وَ طَوْلَكَ
Translation: Let Your grace and bounty overflow upon me

Arabic text: وَ أَيِّدْنِيْ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَ تَسْدِيْدِكَ
Translation: Support me with Your success and guidance

Arabic text: وَ أَعِنِّيْ عَلَى صَالِحِ النِّيَّةِ وَ مَرْضِيِّ الْقَوْلِ وَ مُسْتَحْسَنِ الْعَمَلِ
Translation: Help me toward righteous intention, pleasing words, and approved deeds

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَكِلْنِيْ إِلَى حَوْلِيْ وَ قُوَّتِيْ دُوْنَ حَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ
Translation: Do not leave me to my own power and strength apart from Your power and strength

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُخْزِنِيْ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُنِيْ لِلِقَائِكَ
Translation: Do not disgrace me on the day You raise me up to meet You

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
Translation: Do not expose me before Your friends

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُنْسِنِيْ ذِكْرَكَ وَ لَا تُذْهِبْ عَنِّيْ شُكْرَكَ
Translation: Do not make me forget Your remembrance, nor take away from me Your thanks

Arabic text: بَلْ أَلْزِمْنِيهِ فِيْ أَحْوَالِ السَّهْوِ عِنْدَ غَفَلَاتِ الْجَاهِلِينَ لِآلَائِكَ
Translation: But make it incumbent upon me in times of forgetfulness when the ignorant neglect Your blessings

Arabic text: وَ أَوْزِعْنِيْ أَنْ أُثْنِيَ بِمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِيهِ
Translation: Inspire me to praise what You have bestowed upon me

Arabic text: وَ أَعْتَرِفَ بِمَا أَسْدَيْتَهُ إِلَيَّ
Translation: And acknowledge what You have done for me

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ رَغْبَتِيْ إِلَيْكَ فَوْقَ رَغْبَةِ الرَّاغِبِينَ
Translation: Make my desire for You above the desire of all who desire

Arabic text: وَ حَمْدِيْ إِيَّاكَ فَوْقَ حَمْدِ الْحَامِدِيْنَ
Translation: And my praise for You above the praise of all who praise

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَخْذُلْنِيْ عِنْدَ فَاقَتِيْ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Do not abandon me when I am in need of You

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ بِمَا أَسْدَيْتُهُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Do not destroy me for what I have done for You

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْبَهْنِيْ بِمَا جَبَهْتَ بِهِ الْمُعَانِدِيْنَ لَكَ
Translation: Do not confront me with what You confront Your enemies

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ لَكَ مُسَلِّمٌ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الْحُجَّةَ لَكَ
Translation: For I am submissive to You, I know that the argument is Yours

Arabic text: وَ أَنَّكَ أَوْلَى بِالْفَضْلِ وَ أَعْوَدُ بِالْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: And that You are most worthy of bounty and most generous in beneficence

Arabic text: وَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَ أَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
Translation: And most worthy of piety and most worthy of forgiveness

Arabic text: وَ أَنَّكَ بِأَنْ تَعْفُوَ أَوْلَى مِنْكَ بِأَنْ تُعَاقِبَ
Translation: And that You are more inclined to pardon than to punish

Arabic text: وَ أَنَّكَ بِأَنْ تَسْتُرَ أَقْرَبُ مِنْكَ إِلَى أَنْ تَشْهَرَ
Translation: And that You are more inclined to conceal than to expose

Arabic text: فَأَحْيِنِيْ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً تَنْتَظِمُ بِمَا أُرِيدُ
Translation: So give me a life that is good, well-ordered with what I want

Arabic text: وَ تَبْلُغُ مَا أُحِبُّ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا آتِيْ مَا تَكْرَهُ
Translation: And reaches what I love, in a way that I do not do what You dislike

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَرْتَكِبُ مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ
Translation: And do not commit what You have prohibited

Arabic text: وَ أَمِتْنِيْ مِيتَةَ مَنْ يَسْعَى نُوْرُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ
Translation: And make me die the death of one whose light runs before him and on his right hand

Arabic text: وَ ذَلِّلْنِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ وَ أَعِزَّنِيْ عِنْدَ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: Make me humble before You and exalt me before Your creation

Arabic text: وَ ضَعْنِيْ إِذَا خَلَوْتُ بِكَ وَ ارْفَعْنِيْ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: Lower me when I am alone with You and raise me among Your servants

Arabic text: وَ أَغْنِنِيْ عَمَّنْ هُوَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِّي
Translation: Free me from need for one who has no need of me

Arabic text: وَ زِدْنِيْ إِلَيْكَ فَاقَةً وَ فَقْرًا
Translation: And increase me in poverty and need toward You

Arabic text: وَ أَعِذْنِيْ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
Translation: Protect me from the gloating of enemies

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ حُلُوْلِ الْبَلَاءِ وَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَ الْعَنَاءِ
Translation: From the coming of affliction, from lowliness and suffering

Arabic text: تَغَمَّدْنِيْ فِيمَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنِّي
Translation: Cover me in what You know of me

Arabic text: بِمَا يَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى الْبَطْشِ لَوْلَا حِلْمُهُ
Translation: With the covering of one who, were it not for his clemency, could seize in punishment

Arabic text: وَ الْآخِذُ عَلَى الْجَرِيرَةِ لَوْلَا أَنَاتُهُ
Translation: And who, were it not for his forbearance, would take to task for offenses

Arabic text: وَ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ بِقَوْمٍ فِتْنَةً أَوْ سُوءًا فَنَجِّنِيْ مِنْهَا لِوَاذًا بِكَ
Translation: When You desire for a people trial or evil, deliver me from it, for I seek refuge in You

Arabic text: وَ إِذْ لَمْ تُقِمْنِيْ مَقَامَ فَضِيحَةٍ فِيْ دُنْيَاكَ فَلَا تُقِمْنِيْ مِثْلَهُ فِيْ آخِرَتِكَ
Translation: And since You have not established me in a disgraceful position in this world, do not establish me in a similar one in the Hereafter

Arabic text: وَ اشْفَعْ لِيْ أَوَائِلَ مِنَنِكَ بِأَوَاخِرِهَا
Translation: Join for me the beginnings of Your favors with their ends

Arabic text: وَ قَدِيمَ فَوَائِدِكَ بِحَوَادِثِهَا
Translation: And the ancient of Your benefits with the new

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَمْدُدْ لِيْ مَدًّا يَقْسُوْ مَعَهُ قَلْبِي
Translation: Do not prolong my term with a prolonging that hardens my heart

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَقْرَعْنِيْ قَارِعَةً يَذْهَبُ لَهَا بَهَائِي
Translation: Do not strike me with a striking that takes away my splendor

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَسُمْنِيْ خَسِيسَةً يَصْغُرُ لَهَا قَدْرِي
Translation: Do not assign to me a lowliness that diminishes my worth

Arabic text: وَ لَا نَقِيصَةً يُجْهَلُ مِنْ أَجْلِهَا مَكَانِي
Translation: Or a deficiency that keeps my rank unknown

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَرُعْنِيْ رَوْعَةً أُبْلِسُ بِهَا وَ لَا خِيفَةً أُوجِسُ دُونَهَا
Translation: Do not frighten me with a fright by which I despair, nor a fear I dread

Arabic text: اِجْعَلْ هَيْبَتِيْ فِيْ وَعِيدِكَ
Translation: Make my awe in Your threats

Arabic text: وَ حَذَرِيْ مِنْ إِعْذَارِكَ وَ إِنْذَارِكَ
Translation: My caution from Your admonition and warning

Arabic text: وَ رَهْبَتِيْ عِنْدَ تِلَاوَةِ آيَاتِكَ
Translation: And my fear at the recitation of Your verses

Arabic text: وَ اعْمُرْ لَيْلِيْ بِإِيقَاظِيْ فِيهِ لِعِبَادَتِكَ
Translation: Prosper my night with wakefulness in it for Your worship

Arabic text: وَ تَفَرُّدِيْ بِالتَّهَجُّدِ لَكَ وَ تَجَرُّدِيْ بِسُكُونِيْ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And my being alone in vigil for You, my devotion to You in solitude

Arabic text: وَ إِنْزَالِ حَوَائِجِيْ بِكَ
Translation: And my presenting my needs to You

Arabic text: وَ مُنَازَلَتِيْ إِيَّاكَ فِيْ فَكَاكِ رَقَبَتِيْ مِنْ نَارِكَ
Translation: And my beseeching You to free my neck from the Fire

Arabic text: وَ إِجَارَتِيْ مِمَّا فِيهِ أَهْلُهَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ
Translation: And granting me sanctuary from what those who will suffer punishment face

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَذَرْنِيْ فِيْ طُغْيَانِيْ عَامِهًا
Translation: And do not leave me blindly wandering in my rebellion

Arabic text: وَ لَا فِيْ غَمْرَتِيْ سَاهِيًا حَتَّى حِينٍ
Translation: Or bewildered in my error for a time

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ عِظَةً لِمَنِ اتَّعَظَ وَ لَا نَكَالًا لِمَنِ اعْتَبَرَ
Translation: Do not make me an example for those who take warning, nor a punishment for those who learn lessons

Arabic text: وَ لَا فِتْنَةً لِمَنْ نَظَرَ وَ لَا تَمْكُرْ بِيْ فِيمَنْ تَمْكُرُ بِهِ
Translation: Do not make me a trial for those who observe, and do not plot against me along with those against whom You plot

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَسْتَبْدِلْ بِيْ غَيْرِيْ وَ لَا تُغَيِّرْ لِيْ اسْمًا
Translation: Do not replace me with another, do not change my name

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُبَدِّلْ لِيْ جِسْمًا وَ لَا تَتَّخِذْنِيْ هُزُوًا لِخَلْقِكَ
Translation: Do not transform my form, do not make me a mockery for Your creation

Arabic text: وَ لَا سُخْرِيًّا لَكَ وَ لَا تَبَعًا إِلَّا لِمَرْضَاتِكَ
Translation: Nor a follower of anything but Your pleasure, nor servile except in seeking revenge for You

Arabic text: وَ لَا مُمْتَهَنًا إِلَّا بِالِانْتِقَامِ لَكَ، وَ أَوْجِدْنِيْ بَرْدَ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: Let me taste the coolness of Your pardon, and let me experience the sweetness of Your mercy, Your repose, Your ease, and the garden of Your bliss

Arabic text: وَ حَلَاوَةَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ رَوْحِكَ وَ رَيْحَانِكَ وَ جَنَّةِ نَعِيمِكَ
Translation: Let me taste the flavor of being free for what You love, with ample opportunity for what pleases You

Arabic text: وَ أَذِقْنِيْ طَعْمَ الْفَرَاغِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ بِسَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِكَ
Translation: And striving in what brings me near to You and to You

Arabic text: وَ الِاجْتِهَادِ فِيمَا يُزْلِفُ لَدَيْكَ وَ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: And gift me with one of Your gifts

Arabic text: وَ أَتْحِفْنِيْ بِتُحْفَةٍ مِنْ تُحَفَاتِكَ
Translation: Make my commerce profitable and my return without loss

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ تِجَارَتِيْ رَابِحَةً وَ كَرَّتِيْ غَيْرَ خَاسِرَةٍ
Translation: Fill me with fear of Your position and longing for Your meeting

Arabic text: وَ أَخِفْنِيْ مَقَامَكَ وَ شَوِّقْنِيْ لِقَاءَكَ
Translation: Allow me to repent with a sincere repentance that leaves no sins, small or great

Arabic text: وَ تُبْ عَلَيَّ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا لَا تُبْقِ مَعَهَا ذُنُوبًا صَغِيرَةً وَ لَا كَبِيرَةً
Translation: And leaves behind no apparent or secret offense

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَذَرْ مَعَهَا عَلَانِيَةً وَ لَا سَرِيرَةً
Translation: Remove rancor toward the believers from my chest

Arabic text: وَ انْزَعِ الْغِلَّ مِنْ صَدْرِيْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: Make my heart tender toward the humble

Arabic text: وَ اعْطِفْ بِقَلْبِيْ عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
Translation: Be for me as You are for the righteous

Arabic text: وَ كُنْ لِيْ كَمَا تَكُونُ لِلصَّالِحِيْنَ
Translation: Adorn me with the adornment of the pious

Arabic text: وَ حَلِّنِيْ حِلْيَةَ الْمُتَّقِينَ
Translation: Appoint for me a goodly report among those yet to come

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ لِيْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِيْ الْغَابِرِينَ
Translation: And a growing remembrance among the later folk, and take me to the plain of those who came first

Arabic text: وَ ذِكْرًا نَامِيًا فِيْ الْآخِرِينَ، وَ وَافِ بِيْ عَرْصَةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
Translation: Complete the lavishness of Your blessing upon me, and make its honors descend upon me

Arabic text: وَ تَمِّمْ سُبُوغَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَ ظَاهِرْ كَرَامَاتِهَا لَدَيَّ
Translation: Fill my hand with Your benefits, and drive the noblest of Your gifts to me

Arabic text: اِمْلَأْ مِنْ فَوَائِدِكَ يَدِيْ، وَ سُقْ كَرَائِمَ مَوَاهِبِكَ إِلَيَّ
Translation: Make me the neighbor of the best of Your friends

Arabic text: وَ جَاوِرْ بِيَ الْأَطْيَبِينَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
Translation: In the Gardens which You have adorned for Your chosen

Arabic text: فِيْ الْجِنَانِ الَّتِيْ زَيَّنْتَهَا لِأَصْفِيَائِكَ
Translation: Clothe me in Your noble gifts in the stations prepared for Your beloved

Arabic text: وَ جَلِّلْنِيْ شَرَائِفَ نِحَلِكَ فِيْ الْمَقَامَاتِ الْمُعَدَّةِ لِأَحِبَّائِكَ
Translation: Appoint for me a resting place with You where I can seek refuge serenely

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ مَقِيلًا آوِيْ إِلَيْهِ مُطْمَئِنًّا
Translation: And a resort to which I can return and rest contentedly

Arabic text: وَ مَثَابَةً أَتَبَوَّؤُهَا وَ أَقَرُّ عَيْنًا
Translation: Do not compare me with the great sins

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُقَايِسْنِيْ بِعَظِيمَاتِ الْجَرَائِرِ
Translation: And do not destroy me on the day when secrets are tested

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ
Translation: Remove from me every doubt and uncertainty

Arabic text: وَ أَزِلْ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ شَكٍّ وَ شُبْهَةٍ
Translation: And make for me a path to the truth from every mercy

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْ الْحَقِّ طَرِيقًا مِنْ كُلِّ رَحْمَةٍ
Translation: Make plentiful for me the portions of gifts from Your granting

Arabic text: وَ أَجْزِلْ لِيْ قِسَمَ الْمَوَاهِبِ مِنْ نَوَالِكَ
Translation: And fulfill for me the shares of beneficence from Your bestowal

Arabic text: وَ وَفِّرْ عَلَيَّ حُظُوظَ الْإِحْسَانِ مِنْ إِفْضَالِكَ
Translation: Make my heart confident in what is with You

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ قَلْبِيْ وَاثِقًا بِمَا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: And my concern devoted to what is Yours

Arabic text: وَ هَمِّيْ مُسْتَفْرَغًا لِمَا هُوَ لَكَ
Translation: Employ me in that which You employ Your pure ones

Arabic text: وَ اسْتَعْمِلْنِيْ بِمَا تَسْتَعْمِلُ بِهِ خَالِصَتَكَ
Translation: Steep my heart in Your obedience when intellects are bewildered

Arabic text: وَ أَشْرِبْ قَلْبِيْ عِنْدَ ذُهُولِ الْعُقُولِ طَاعَتَكَ
Translation: Combine for me wealth, chastity, ease, well-being

Arabic text: وَ اجْمَعْ لِيَ الْغِنَى وَ الْعَفَافَ وَ الدَّعَةَ وَ الْمُعَافَاةَ
Translation: Health, plenty, tranquility, and security

Arabic text: وَ الصِّحَّةَ وَ السَّعَةَ وَ الطُّمَأْنِيْنَةَ وَ الْعَافِيَةَ
Translation: Do not nullify my good deeds by what comes into them from Your disobedience

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُحْبِطْ حَسَنَاتِيْ بِمَا يَشُوبُهَا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: Nor my privacy by the intrusion of the trials You cause

Arabic text: وَ لَا خَلَوَاتِيْ بِمَا يَعْرِضُ لِيْ مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ فِتْنَتِكَ
Translation: Safeguard my face from seeking help from anyone in the worlds

Arabic text: وَ صُنْ وَجْهِيْ عَنِ الطَّلَبِ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: Drive me away from seeking assistance from the ungodly

Arabic text: وَ ذُبَّنِيْ عَنِ الْتِمَاسِ مَا عِنْدَ الْفَاسِقِينَ
Translation: Do not make me a helper to the wrongdoers

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ لِلظَّالِمِيْنَ ظَهِيرًا
Translation: Nor their ally in erasing Your Book

Arabic text: وَ لَا لَهُمْ عَلَى مَحْوِ كِتَابِكَ يَدًا وَ نَصِيرًا
Translation: Protect me in a way I do not know, with a protection that will preserve me

Arabic text: وَ حُطْنِيْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا أَعْلَمُ حِيَاطَةً تَقِينِيْ بِهَا
Translation: Open for me the gates of Your repentance, Your mercy, Your kindness, and Your plentiful provision

Arabic text: وَ افْتَحْ لِيْ أَبْوَابَ تَوْبَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ رَأْفَتِكَ وَ رِزْقِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
Translation: Surely I am one of those who desire You

Arabic text: إِنِّيْ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الرَّاغِبِينَ
Translation: Complete Your favor upon me, for You are the best of those who show favor

Arabic text: وَ أَتْمِمْ لِيْ إِنْعَامَكَ إِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْعِمِيْنَ
Translation: Make the rest of my life a pilgrimage and an umrah

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ بَاقِيَ عُمْرِيْ فِيْ الْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةِ
Translation: Seeking Your face, O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اِبْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad and his pure and immaculate family

Arabic text: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: And peace be upon him and upon them for all eternity

Arabic text: وَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِيْنَ
Translation: And peace be upon him and upon them forever and ever
